research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand is continuous with moderate variability (CV=0.263) and near-daily non-zero consumption (99.2% of working days), making a fixed-order-quantity (r,Q) model appropriate. Lead times are unstable and short (mean=1.65 wd), so a continuous review trigger at the ROP provides timely replenishment without complex periodic-review overhead.
